_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2011 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2011 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.30x; +47% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.68; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.3%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2011-07-29) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.30x (30.1% downside to Bear $63 / +23.1% upside to Bull $111) | Adj composite 2.49 vs market 3.17: gap -0.68 [OVERVALUED] | +47% above the EPP floor $61 (14x FY12E $4.39) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.5% total (+1.8%/yr) | At 20.5x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $119 sits above the BULL case; futures orders +15.0% in Q4 FY11, forward revenues +11% (Q4 FY11 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
